name: compiler-img
description: DSL-based image compiler: lexer, parser, semantic analyzer and SVG/PNG code generator, exposed as a web app.

scripts.build:deps: npm run build:shared && npm run build:grpc-contracts && npm run build:compiler-core && npm run build:compiler
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:deps && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.proto:check: npm run proto:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/grpc-contracts/src/generated
